The MR protocol for the Oxford site

output.population: 51 participants scanned at Bangor and Oxford, all of whom had previously completed an online behavioural session and an fTCD session
output.summary: Raw fMRI data from six language tasks scanned at two sites, Bangor and Oxford, collected to test how closely laterality indices from functional transcranial doppler sonography and fMRI correlate; participant file includes fTCD laterality indices.
